name: ai-fantasy-football
description: A local-first, Codex-driven fantasy football front office.

scripts.lint: eslint . && cd services/analytics && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd services/analytics && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd services/analytics && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.data:seed: cd services/analytics && uv run ai-ff-analytics seed
scripts.ci: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
